pr_title: Make PodResources API include restartable init containers

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Currently, the PodResources API of kubelet does not take restartable init containers into account.

This PR makes PodResource API include restartable init containers when the `SidecarContainers` feature gate is enabled.

-->

```release-note
Node podresources API now includes init containers with containerRestartPolicy of `Always` when `SidecarContainers` feature is enabled.
```

issue_context.title: PodResources API of kubelet does not report the resources allocated to restartable init containers
issue_context.body:
previous discussion: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/120461#discussion_r1317515863

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/56cc5e77a10ba156694309d9b6159d4cd42598e1/pkg/kubelet/apis/podresources/server_v1.go#L51-L86

kubelet's PodResources API does not report the resources allocated to restartable init containers.
This should be fixed before we move to the beta stage.

/sig-node
/kind bug

/cc @ffromani @tzneal @SergeyKanzhelev
comments:
/triage accepted
/priority important-longterm

I'm convinced we should still NOT report resources for regular init container. Only sidecar containers should be reported, because they match or exceed the lifetime of app container.

> I'm convinced we should still NOT report resources for regular init container. Only sidecar containers should be reported, because they match or exceed the lifetime of app container.

That seems reasonable for me as well.
